title: trisetum phleoides
intro: Trisetum phleoides, commonly known as Needle Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and soothe digestive issues. The health benefits of Trisetum phleoides are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
